from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from a single company's 2025 Q1 report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    capital_reserve: str | None = Field(description="Capital Reserve amount as stated in the report")
    undistributed_profit: str | None = Field(description="Undistributed Profit amount as stated in the report")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period end date or label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate of all company financial data found across the documents."""
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialData]
